facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 53°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 2 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations between 20 days earlier and 1 day later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 8 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: left June 13; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 25 (2024), June 12 (2025)

evidence.name: Pope Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: May 6 (2023), April 22 (2024), April 26 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) and the lowest at Trinity (2,890 ft) and Pope Ridge (3,590 ft).

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: 20.1 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 26.9 in (2023), 21.3 in (2024), 26.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Lyman Lake

evidence.name: Pope Ridge

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 25 and July 10, carried from the melt-out date at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.detail: melted out June 13, 234 ft below the pass; points to May 25 to July 10
